Preview images, videos, and PDFs right on the share page, before downloading.

## Added

- **Inline preview.** Image (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, AVIF), video (MP4, WebM, OGG), and PDF shares can be viewed directly on the download page before saving. Decryption stays client-side — the server never sees the content. In a multi-file share, each previewable file gets its own Preview toggle.

## Notes

- Previewing never costs an extra download: it reuses the bytes already decrypted in the browser, so a download-limited or burn-after-download share is still counted as one unit.
- Only inert media types preview (no SVG/HTML), and previews are capped at 50 MB to keep memory bounded; larger files show a "download to view" note. Streaming preview of very large videos is a planned follow-up.
